stock_outlook.thesis_summary: Durable cash generation and operating leverage support a somewhat bullish medium-term outlook.
key_drivers: FCF margin expanded to 14.2% in FY2025 (durable cash generation)
Gross Merchandise Volume grew 23% YoY to $281B
Operating leverage is materializing as headcount growth slows
Balance sheet is strong with low meaningful debt

final_recommendation.executive_summary: Shopify presents a compelling medium-term buy. Cash flow has turned decisively positive and margins are expanding. The main risk is valuation — any deceleration in growth could compress the multiple. The risk/reward still favors initiating or adding a position with conservative sizing.
final_recommendation.cio_rationale: I weight the bull case more heavily here. FCF generation is no longer speculative — it is demonstrated. The Shopify Payments attach rate is accelerating and creates meaningful operating leverage. The bear case correctly identifies valuation risk, but I assess this as a timing/entry risk rather than a thesis risk. The risk advisor's 5% position size recommendation is appropriate given the disagreement and valuation premium.

layer2_context.portfolio_fit_rationale: This medium-term growth thesis matches a registered-account allocation focused on capital appreciation.
layer2_context.suggested_action: Hold and consider adding on pullbacks toward support; keep sizing conservative given valuation risk.
